## Practical, ethical approach to growing real accounts (no deception)

**Example (Python) to analyze your real account’s post performance from a CSV export**  
(Export your post analytics to CSV, then run this.)

```python
import pandas as pd

# Example CSV columns: date, platform, post_id, impressions, likes, comments, shares
df = pd.read_csv("post_analytics.csv", parse_dates=["date"])

# Basic engagement rate (customize to your platform metrics)
df["engagements"] = df["likes"] + df["comments"] + df["shares"]
df["engagement_rate"] = df["engagements"] / df["impressions"].clip(lower=1)

# See best posts
top = df.sort_values("engagement_rate", ascending=False).head(10)
print(top[["date", "platform", "post_id", "impressions", "engagements", "engagement_rate"]])

# Weekly trend
weekly = df.set_index("date").resample("W")[["impressions", "engagements"]].sum()
weekly["engagement_rate"] = weekly["engagements"] / weekly["impressions"].clip(lower=1)
print("\nWeekly summary:\n", weekly.tail(12))
```
